content: PostgreSQL has no native autonomous transaction (no PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION). Two established emulation approaches: (1) dblink extension opens a second physical connection and executes+commits independently of caller's transaction — mature but connection-overhead heavy; (2) pg_background extension spawns a background worker to run a statement in its own transaction — lower overhead, but is a third-party extension not in core/orafce. Both require deliberate migration since Oracle autonomous-transaction procedures (typically used for audit/logging that must survive caller rollback) will silently lose that guarantee if translated as ordinary function calls.
